justification: GATE-2b: the SEPP override loop applied an override to ANY dev_type via the `or not applied_overrides` fallback, so an LMR form bonus (e.g. dual-occupancy/manor 9.5m) inflated a dwelling_house's height/storeys (seen on 17 Corden Ave Five Dock: LEP 8.5m -> effective 9.5m, 3 storeys, with 'Housing SEPP: No'). The override now applies only when its dev_type matches the computed form.

pre_impl.existing_data: SeppLepOverride carries its own dev_type; the SEPP override loop in compute_constraint_arithmetic already iterated overrides and raised effective_height / effective_fsr when more generous.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: GATE-2 fixed override eligibility and heritage but left the audit's finding #4 in place: `if ovr.dev_type == dev_type or not applied_overrides` applied the FIRST override regardless of form, so a dwelling_house inherited an LMR-form height/FSR bonus.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One-condition change: drop the `or not applied_overrides` fallback so an override applies only to its own form. No new data; the engine's envelope maths are unchanged otherwise.
pre_impl.external_source_error: N/A - pure function; no external call. The override list is pre-fetched; this only changes which entries are applied.
pre_impl.frontend_type: N/A - backend only; effective_height_m / effective_fsr / sepp_overrides_applied keep their types, just no longer mis-populated for a mismatched form. Capacity card stays unexposed.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Where FSR binds (as on 17 Corden) the over-applied height did not change yield, but the height/storeys figures were wrong on screen; on a height-bound lot it over-reported yield. The fix removes both; it can only REMOVE an incorrectly-applied override, never add one.

functions.name: compute_constraint_arithmetic
functions.input: lot area, dev_type, LEP height/FSR strings, lot dimensions, DCP controls, SEPP standards and SEPP-LEP overrides
functions.output: the constraint result; effective_height/effective_fsr now reflect only overrides whose form matches dev_type
functions.if_none: no overrides, or no override matching the dev_type, leaves the LEP height and FSR unchanged

values: N/A - no regulatory values hardcoded; override values come from the SEPP standards already fetched, compared strictly greater than the LEP control.
queries: N/A - no database queries; the override loop is a pure in-memory comparison.

break_it.scenario: A dwelling house on a lot where an LMR form (dual occupancy) has a 9.5m SEPP height standard
break_it.what_happens: The fallback applied the dual-occupancy 9.5m bonus to the dwelling_house computation, inflating effective height and storeys
break_it.how: the loop now requires ovr.dev_type == dev_type; test_override_does_not_apply_to_mismatched_form asserts effective_height stays 8.5 and no override is recorded

break_it.scenario: A genuinely matching form must still receive its SEPP override
break_it.what_happens: Over-tightening would drop a legitimate uplift for the form it belongs to
break_it.how: the match condition passes for the same form; test_override_applies_to_matching_form asserts effective_height becomes 9.5

break_it.scenario: An FSR bonus for a denser form leaks onto a dwelling house
break_it.what_happens: A residential-flat FSR uplift could inflate a dwelling_house FSR and GFA envelope
break_it.how: the same dev_type match gates FSR overrides too; test_fsr_override_only_for_matching_form asserts effective_fsr stays 0.5

break_it.scenario: A SEPP value equal to the LEP value for the matching form
break_it.what_happens: A non-uplift equal value could be recorded as an applied override
break_it.how: the strict '>' comparison is preserved; test_override_ignored_when_not_more_generous asserts no override is applied

break_it.scenario: Removing the fallback regresses an existing constraint test that relied on it
break_it.what_happens: An older test could have depended on the cross-form override behaviour
break_it.repro: run the full constraint_arithmetic + dwelling_form suites
break_it.how: 102 constraint/form tests pass with no regression — no existing test relied on the buggy fallback

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-run 17 Corden Ave Five Dock and confirm effective height stays 8.5m / 2 storeys (no SEPP override applied to the dwelling_house) and 'SEPP overrides applied' is 0. This closes the audit's finding #4; the LMR 800m-catchment and lot-width eligibility check remain a finer-grained residual. Engine stays unexposed until the polish pass.
